'''Jaden Korr's lightsaber''' was a weapon, originally constructed by a [[Alpha (clone)|clone]] of [[Kam Solusar]], which was later owned by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].

==History==
===Creation===
After leaving behind his [[Jaden Korr's second lightsaber|second lightsaber]] on the [[frozen moon]],<ref name="CC" /> Korr used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Cleanse|purify]] the [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|unstable red crystal]] of the weapon. This caused the blade to shine [[Color/Legends|yellow]], the color Korr noted had once been a symbol of the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]].<ref name="Riptide" />

===Tracking the clones===

===Rising tensions===
{{Quote|Now, Jedi Korr, perhaps you'd be good enough to tell us why you ignored orders and allowed the Solos to interrupt us?''"<br />"''I'm sorry, Master Horn. I didn't have a choice.|Corran Horn and Jaden Korr|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
Later, Korr was stationed outside the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chambers]] alongside a male Human and a female [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] apprentice by order of acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] while the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]] discussed how to proceed with the arrest warrants against Jedi [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]]. When Jedi Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her [[Han Solo/Legends|husband]] arrived in the foyer to the chambers, Korr initially upheld his mandate to bar entrance to everyone. However, the Solos soon convinced Korr that they had evidence of an attack by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on the Temple, and he let them pass. Jedi Master [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and Acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] expressed their displeasure with Korr's decision to let the Solos interrupt the Masters, but Kyle Katarn insisted that the arrests should have been carried out in another location. Korr later assisted in [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|moving]] the Jedi affected by [[Force psychosis]] and, along with [[Avinoam Arelis]], helped the Solos defend against the [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s in a [[Jedi Temple/Legends|lower level hangar]] in the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]].<ref name="Abyss" />
